CHANGELOG updated in PARENA: Root-caused and fixed a real Windows DPI-awareness bug making mouse click/drag coordinates wrong in the PARENA editor (SDL_HINT_WINDOWS_DPI_AWARENESS=permonitorv2); added a hover-reveal status bar (auto-indent toggle) that stays hidden except near the bottom edge. v0.79.0 (sess-20260825-1938-f6bd411e) (sess-20260825-1938-f6bd411e)
